description:
[DEFRA & GLEC freight logistics carbon engine. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates Scope 3 Category 4/9 freight transport emissions across road HGV (Euro 4-6), rail (electric/diesel), maritime, and air cargo based on ISO 14083:2023 and GLEC Framework v3.0, reporting Tank-to-Wheel (TTW) and Well-to-Wheel (WTW) emissions.
Usage: Use this tool to calculate logistics and supply chain transportation carbon footprints per tonne-kilometre (t*km).
Returns: JSON object with { cargoWeightMetricTons: number, distanceKm: number, transportMode: string, tonneKilometres: number, emissionFactors: object, calculatedTotals: object, glecFrameworkAlignment: object }.

cargoWeightMetricTons.description: Weight of cargo in metric tonnes

isRefrigeratedTemperatureControlled.description: True if cargo requires active temperature-controlled refrigeration (+18% fuel penalty)

name: defra_freight_logistics_calculator
